rundown: Badgers beat Leopards 83-41 at Kohl Center in Madison, WI in front of 2,727. Badgers led 40-22 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: Badgers won it 23-7. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 99%).
Leading the way — Leopards: Teresa Kiewiet 12 pts; Reneyia Pickering 2 ast; Tasha Chudy 6 reb. Badgers: Adaline Sheplee 14 pts, 6 reb; Kadidia Toure 5 ast.
Where Badgers won it: they shot 50% to 33%, shot 38% from three to 19% and won the boards 41-29.

review.body:

Projected to score 83.4, they scored 83 (−0.4 points, 0% under); projected to allow 51.4, they allowed 41 (−10.4 points, 20% under).

The bigger miss was Leopards' scoring (-10.4 points against projection).
